plain_english_revision: The amendment adds the University of South Alabama (USA) as a potential partner in administering or overseeing the proposed Cyber Engineering School. It specifically includes the President of USA—or their designee—as a voting member on the governing board, without altering other eligibility criteria or funding conditions.
candidate_position_supported: Institutional collaboration: Ensures state universities (specifically USA) have a formal role in shaping the Cyber Engineering School’s governance, programs, or eligibility standards.
evidence_quotes: The President of the University of South Alabama, or his or her designee.
review_reason: No hidden dependencies on unseen language; amendment is self-contained and procedural in scope.
